========================================== */

}

    font-size:15px;
    line-height:1.5;
    font-weight:500;

/* Models / Series / OTT / Tags */

.hs-live-meta{
    margin-top:6px;

    color:#999;

    font-size:12px;
    line-height:1.5;
}

.hs-live-meta i{
    color:#ffc107;
    margin-right:3px;
}

.hs-meta-dot{
    display:inline-block;

    margin:0 7px;

    color:#555;
}


/* ==========================================
   LOADING / EMPTY
========================================== */

.hs-live-loading,
.hs-live-empty{
    padding:30px 15px;

    color:#aaa;

    text-align:center;
}


/* ==========================================
   MOBILE
========================================== */

@media(max-width:768px){

    .hs-search-icon{
        width:38px;
        height:38px;

        margin:0 3px;

        font-size:18px;
    }

    .hs-search-overlay{
        padding:65px 10px 85px;
    }

    .hs-search-modal{
        padding:18px;
    }

    .hs-search-heading{
        font-size:20px;
    }

    #hs-search-input{
        padding:13px;

    }

        font-size:11px;
        margin-top:4px;
    }

}




/* =========================================================
   COMPACT SINGLE POST TAXONOMY BOX
   Series / Models / Category / Tags
   PASTE THIS AT VERY BOTTOM OF ADDITIONAL CSS
========================================================= */


/* Main taxonomy box */

.episode-tags{
    width:100%;
    box-sizing:border-box;

    background:#111;

    padding:10px 14px !important;
    margin-top:12px !important;

    border-radius:12px;

    overflow:hidden;
}


/* ==========================================
   SERIES / MODELS / CATEGORY / TAG ROWS
========================================== */

.episode-tags p{
    margin:0 !important;
    padding:4px 0 !important;

    line-height:1.35 !important;
}


/* Yellow labels */

.episode-tags strong{
    display:inline-block;

    color:#ffc107 !important;

    margin-right:6px !important;

    white-space:nowrap;
}


/* Taxonomy buttons */

.episode-tags a{
    display:inline-block !important;

    background:#222 !important;
    color:#fff !important;

    padding:5px 10px !important;

    margin:1px 3px 1px 0 !important;

    border-radius:20px !important;

    font-size:12px !important;

    line-height:1.4 !important;

    white-space:nowrap;

    text-decoration:none !important;

    transition:.2s;
}


/* Hover */

.episode-tags a:hover{
    background:#ffc107 !important;
    color:#000 !important;
}



/* =========================================================
   TAGS ROW
   Your Tags row is the LAST <p> in this box.
   Keep everything on ONE horizontal line.
========================================================= */

.episode-tags p:last-child{
    display:flex !important;

    align-items:center;

    width:100%;

    gap:5px;

    margin:0 !important;

    padding:4px 0 5px !important;

    overflow-x:auto !important;
    overflow-y:hidden !important;

    white-space:nowrap !important;

    -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;

    scrollbar-width:none;
}


/* Hide scrollbar - Chrome/Safari */

.episode-tags p:last-child::-webkit-scrollbar{
    display:none;
}


/* Keep "Tags :" at beginning */

.episode-tags p:last-child strong{
    flex:0 0 auto;
}


/* Each tag stays separate and does not wrap */

.episode-tags p:last-child a{
    flex:0 0 auto;

    margin:0 !important;
}



/* =========================================================
   MOBILE
========================================================= */

@media(max-width:768px){

    .episode-tags{
        padding:8px 9px !important;
        margin-top:8px !important;

        border-radius:10px;

       Series / Models / Category / Tags */

    .episode-tags p{
        margin:0 !important;
        padding:3px 0 !important;

        line-height:1.25 !important;
    }


    .episode-tags strong{
        margin-right:4px !important;

        font-size:12px !important;
    }


    .episode-tags a{
        padding:4px 8px !important;

        margin:1px 2px 1px 0 !important;

        font-size:11px !important;

        line-height:1.3 !important;
    }


    /* Tags = one swipeable row */

    .episode-tags p:last-child{
        gap:4px;

        padding:3px 0 4px !important;

        overflow-x:auto !important;

        white-space:nowrap !important;
    }


    .episode-tags p:last-child a{
        margin:0 !important;
    }

}

<script>
(function(){

    let searchTimer = null;
    let controller  = null;


    /* =========================================
       CLICK HANDLING
    ========================================= */

    document.addEventListener('click', function(event){

        const openButton =
            event.target.closest('.hs-search-open-btn');

        const closeButton =
            event.target.closest('.hs-search-close');

        const overlay =
            document.getElementById('hs-search-overlay');

        const input =
            document.getElementById('hs-search-input');


        /* -------------------------
           OPEN SEARCH
        ------------------------- */

        if(openButton){

            /*
             * Stop this specific search-button click
             * from bubbling into other click listeners.
             *
             * We intentionally DO NOT use preventDefault().
             */

            event.stopPropagation();

            if(!overlay){
                return;
            }

            overlay.classList.add('active');

            document.body.classList.add(
                'hs-search-active'
            );

            setTimeout(function(){

                if(input){
                    input.focus();
                }

            },100);

            return;
        }


        /* -------------------------
           CLOSE SEARCH
        ------------------------- */

        if(closeButton){

            event.stopPropagation();

            if(overlay){
                overlay.classList.remove('active');
            }

            document.body.classList.remove(
                'hs-search-active'
            );

            return;
        }


        /* -------------------------
           CLICK OUTSIDE MODAL
        ------------------------- */

        if(
            overlay &&
            event.target === overlay
        ){

            overlay.classList.remove('active');

            document.body.classList.remove(
                'hs-search-active'
            );

        }

    });


    /* =========================================
       ESC KEY CLOSE
    ========================================= */

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(event){

        if(event.key !== 'Escape'){
            return;
        }

        const overlay =
            document.getElementById('hs-search-overlay');

        if(overlay){

            overlay.classList.remove('active');

        }

        document.body.classList.remove(
            'hs-search-active'
        );

    });


    /* =========================================
       LIVE AJAX SEARCH
    ========================================= */

    document.addEventListener('input', function(event){

        if(event.target.id !== 'hs-search-input'){
            return;
        }

        const input = event.target;

        const results =
            document.getElementById('hs-live-results');

        if(!results){
            return;
        }


        clearTimeout(searchTimer);


        const keyword =
            input.value.trim();


        /* Minimum 2 characters */

        if(keyword.length < 2){

            results.innerHTML = '';

            return;
        }


        /* Loading */

        results.innerHTML =
            '<div class="hs-live-loading">' +
                '<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> ' +
                'Searching...' +
            '</div>';


        searchTimer = setTimeout(function(){


            /* Check AJAX config */

            if(
                typeof window.hsLiveSearch === 'undefined'
            ){

                results.innerHTML =
                    '<div class="hs-live-empty">' +
                    'Search configuration missing.' +
                    '</div>';

                console.log(
                    'hsLiveSearch configuration missing'
                );

                return;
            }


            /* Cancel previous request */

            if(controller){

                controller.abort();

            }


            controller =
                new AbortController();


            const formData =
                new FormData();


            formData.append(
                'action',
                'hs_live_search'
            );


            formData.append(
                'keyword',
                keyword
            );


            formData.append(
                'nonce',
                window.hsLiveSearch.nonce
            );


            /* AJAX */

            fetch(
                window.hsLiveSearch.ajaxUrl,
                {

                    method:'POST',

                    body:formData,

                    signal:controller.signal

                }
            )

            .then(function(response){

                return response.json();

            })

            .then(function(response){

                if(response.success){

                    results.innerHTML =
                        response.data;

                }else{

                    results.innerHTML =
                        '<div class="hs-live-empty">' +
                        'No results found' +
                        '</div>';

                }

            })

            .catch(function(error){

                if(
                    error.name === 'AbortError'
                ){
                    return;
                }


                console.log(
                    'Search error:',
                    error
                );


                results.innerHTML =
                    '<div class="hs-live-empty">' +
                    'Search unavailable' +
                    '</div>';

            });


        },300);

    });

})();

    (function () {
        'use strict';

        /*
         * Stop the previous live-search
         * input handler from receiving events.
         */
        document.addEventListener('input', function (event) {

            if (
                !event.target ||
                event.target.id !== 'hs-search-input'
            ) {
                return;
            }

            event.stopImmediatePropagation();

            var results = document.getElementById(
                'hs-live-results'
            );

            if (results) {
                results.innerHTML = '';
            }

        }, true);


        function submitHotSeriesSearch(input) {

            var keyword = input.value.trim();

            if (keyword.length < 2) {
                input.focus();
                return;
            }

            var url = new URL('/', window.location.origin);

            url.searchParams.set('s', keyword);

            window.location.assign(url.toString());
        }


        // Press Enter to search.
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {

            if (
                !event.target ||
                event.target.id !== 'hs-search-input'
            ) {
                return;
            }

            if (
                event.key !== 'Enter' ||
                event.isComposing
            ) {
                return;
            }

            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopImmediatePropagation();

            submitHotSeriesSearch(event.target);

        }, true);


        /*
         * Add a Search button inside the
         * existing search field.
         */
        function initializeSearchButton() {

            var input = document.getElementById(
                'hs-search-input'
            );

            if (!input) {
                return;
            }

            var field = input.closest('.hs-search-field');

            if (!field) {
                return;
            }

            // Prevent duplicate buttons.
            if (field.querySelector('.hs-search-submit')) {
                return;
            }

            var button = document.createElement('button');

            button.type = 'button';
            button.className = 'hs-search-submit';
            button.textContent = 'Search';

            button.addEventListener('click', function () {
                submitHotSeriesSearch(input);
            });

            field.appendChild(button);
        }

        if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
            document.addEventListener(
                'DOMContentLoaded',
                initializeSearchButton
            );
        } else {
            initializeSearchButton();
        }

    })();
    </script>

body{

padding-bottom:70px;

}

}


.mobile-bottom-nav i{
    display:block;
    font-size:22px;
    margin-bottom:5px;
}

.mobile-bottom-nav p{
    margin:0;
    font-size:12px;
}

/* Telegram pop up*/

#telegram-popup{

position:fixed;

left:0;

top:0;

width:100%;

height:100%;

background:rgba(0,0,0,.75);

display:flex;

align-items:center;

justify-content:center;

visibility:hidden;

opacity:0;

transition:.3s;

z-index:999999;

}

#telegram-popup.show{

visibility:visible;

opacity:1;

}

.telegram-box{

width:90%;

max-width:420px;

background:#111;

padding:30px;

border-radius:15px;

text-align:center;

position:relative;

box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(0,0,0,.6);

}

.telegram-box h2{

color:#ffc107;

margin-bottom:15px;

font-size:28px;

}

.telegram-box p{

color:#ddd;

line-height:1.8;

margin-bottom:25px;

}

.telegram-btn{

display:inline-block;

padding:12px 30px;

background:#229ED9;

color:#fff;

border-radius:40px;

text-decoration:none;

font-weight:700;

}

.telegram-btn:hover{

background:#0088cc;

}

#telegram-close{

position:absolute;

right:15px;

top:10px;

border:none;

background:none;

font-size:30px;

color:#fff;

cursor:pointer;

}

@media(max-width:768px){

.telegram-box{

padding:25px;

}

.telegram-box h2{

font-size:24px;

}

}

.telegram-box h2 i{
    color:#229ED9;
    margin-right:10px;
    font-size:32px;
    vertical-align:middle;
}





/* ==========================================
   HEADER LIVE SEARCH
========================================== */

.hs-search-icon{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    width:42px;
    height:42px;

    padding:0;
    margin:0 5px;

    border:0 !important;
    outline:0 !important;

    background:transparent !important;
    color:#ffcc00 !important;

    font-size:20px;
    line-height:1;

    cursor:pointer;

    position:relative;
    z-index:10000;
}

.hs-search-icon:hover,
.hs-search-icon:focus{
    color:#fff !important;
    background:transparent !important;
}


/* ==========================================
   SEARCH OVERLAY
========================================== */

.hs-search-overlay{
    position:fixed;
    inset:0;

    width:100%;
    height:100%;

    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
    align-items:flex-start;

    padding:80px 20px 30px;

    background:rgba(0,0,0,.88);

    z-index:9999999;

    opacity:0;
    visibility:hidden;
    pointer-events:none;

    transition:
        opacity .25s ease,
        visibility .25s ease;
}

.hs-search-overlay.active{
    opacity:1;
    visibility:visible;
    pointer-events:auto;
}

body.hs-search-active{
    overflow:hidden;
}


/* ==========================================
   MODAL
========================================== */

.hs-search-modal{
    position:relative;

    width:100%;
    max-width:720px;

    padding:25px;

    background:#111;

    border-radius:14px;

    box-shadow:0 15px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.65);
}


/* ==========================================
   TITLE
========================================== */

.hs-search-heading{
    margin:0 50px 18px 0;

    color:#fff;

    font-size:24px;
    font-weight:600;
}


/* ==========================================
   CLOSE BUTTON
========================================== */

.hs-search-close{
    position:absolute;

    top:14px;
    right:14px;

    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    width:38px;
    height:38px;

    padding:0;

    border:0 !important;
    border-radius:50%;

    background:#222 !important;
    color:#fff !important;

    font-size:18px;

    cursor:pointer;
}

.hs-search-close:hover{
    background:#ffc107 !important;
    color:#000 !important;
}


/* ==========================================
   SEARCH FIELD
========================================== */

.hs-search-field{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;

    width:100%;

    padding-left:16px;

    background:#222;

    border-radius:10px;
}

.hs-search-field > i{
    flex:0 0 auto;

    color:#ffc107;

    font-size:18px;
}

#hs-search-input{
    width:100%;

    padding:15px;

    border:0 !important;
    outline:0 !important;

    background:transparent !important;

    color:#fff;

    font-size:18px;

    box-shadow:none !important;
}

#hs-search-input:focus{
    border:0 !important;
    outline:0 !important;
    box-shadow:none !important;
}

#hs-search-input::placeholder{
    color:#999;
}


/* ==========================================
   RESULTS
========================================== */

.hs-live-results{
    width:100%;

    max-height:520px;

    margin-top:15px;

    overflow-y:auto;
}

.hs-live-result{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;

    gap:15px;

    padding:10px;
    margin-bottom:8px;

    background:#1b1b1b;

    border-radius:9px;

    text-decoration:none !important;

    transition:.2s;
}

.hs-live-result:hover{
    background:#292929;
}


/* ==========================================
   RESULT THUMBNAIL
========================================== */

.hs-live-thumb{
    width:115px;
    flex:0 0 115px;
}

.hs-live-thumb img{
    display:block;

    width:100%;
    height:65px;

    object-fit:cover;

    border-radius:7px;
}

.hs-live-no-image{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    width:100%;
    height:65px;

    background:#292929;

    border-radius:7px;

    color:#777;
}


/* ==========================================
   RESULT INFORMATION
========================================== */

.hs-live-info{
    flex:1;
    min-width:0;
}

.hs-live-title{
    color:#fff;

    font-size:15px;
    line-height:1.5;
    font-weight:500;
}


/* Models / Series / OTT / Tags */

.hs-live-meta{
    margin-top:6px;

    color:#999;

    font-size:12px;
    line-height:1.5;
}

.hs-live-meta i{
    color:#ffc107;
    margin-right:3px;
}

.hs-meta-dot{
    display:inline-block;

    margin:0 7px;

    color:#555;
}


/* ==========================================
   LOADING / EMPTY
========================================== */

.hs-live-loading,
.hs-live-empty{
    padding:30px 15px;

    color:#aaa;

    text-align:center;
}


/* ==========================================
   MOBILE
========================================== */

@media(max-width:768px){

    .hs-search-icon{
        width:38px;
        height:38px;

        margin:0 3px;

        font-size:18px;
    }

    .hs-search-overlay{
        padding:65px 10px 85px;
    }

    .hs-search-modal{
        padding:18px;
    }

    .hs-search-heading{
        font-size:20px;
    }

    #hs-search-input{
        padding:13px;

        font-size:16px;
    }

    .hs-live-thumb{
        width:90px;
        flex-basis:90px;
    }

    .hs-live-thumb img,
    .hs-live-no-image{
        height:55px;
    }

    .hs-live-title{
        font-size:14px;
    }

    .hs-live-meta{
        font-size:11px;
        margin-top:4px;
    }

}




/* =========================================================
   COMPACT SINGLE POST TAXONOMY BOX
   Series / Models / Category / Tags
   PASTE THIS AT VERY BOTTOM OF ADDITIONAL CSS
========================================================= */


/* Main taxonomy box */

.episode-tags{
    width:100%;
    box-sizing:border-box;

    background:#111;

    padding:10px 14px !important;
    margin-top:12px !important;

    border-radius:12px;

    overflow:hidden;
}


/* ==========================================
   SERIES / MODELS / CATEGORY / TAG ROWS
========================================== */

.episode-tags p{
    margin:0 !important;
    padding:4px 0 !important;

    line-height:1.35 !important;
}


/* Yellow labels */

.episode-tags strong{
    display:inline-block;

    color:#ffc107 !important;

    margin-right:6px !important;

    white-space:nowrap;
}


/* Taxonomy buttons */

.episode-tags a{
    display:inline-block !important;

    background:#222 !important;
    color:#fff !important;

    padding:5px 10px !important;

    margin:1px 3px 1px 0 !important;

    border-radius:20px !important;

    font-size:12px !important;

    line-height:1.4 !important;

    white-space:nowrap;

    text-decoration:none !important;

    transition:.2s;
}


/* Hover */

.episode-tags a:hover{
    background:#ffc107 !important;
    color:#000 !important;
}



/* =========================================================
   TAGS ROW
   Your Tags row is the LAST <p> in this box.
   Keep everything on ONE horizontal line.
========================================================= */

.episode-tags p:last-child{
    display:flex !important;

    align-items:center;

    width:100%;

    gap:5px;

    margin:0 !important;

    padding:4px 0 5px !important;

    overflow-x:auto !important;
    overflow-y:hidden !important;

    white-space:nowrap !important;

    -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;

    scrollbar-width:none;
}


/* Hide scrollbar - Chrome/Safari */

.episode-tags p:last-child::-webkit-scrollbar{
    display:none;
}


/* Keep "Tags :" at beginning */

.episode-tags p:last-child strong{
    flex:0 0 auto;
}


/* Each tag stays separate and does not wrap */

.episode-tags p:last-child a{
    flex:0 0 auto;

    margin:0 !important;
}



/* =========================================================
   MOBILE
========================================================= */

@media(max-width:768px){

    .episode-tags{
        padding:8px 9px !important;
        margin-top:8px !important;

        border-radius:10px;
    }


    /* Reduce spacing between
       Series / Models / Category / Tags */

    .episode-tags p{
        margin:0 !important;
        padding:3px 0 !important;

        line-height:1.25 !important;
    }


    .episode-tags strong{
        margin-right:4px !important;

        font-size:12px !important;
    }


    .episode-tags a{
        padding:4px 8px !important;

        margin:1px 2px 1px 0 !important;

        font-size:11px !important;

        line-height:1.3 !important;
    }


    /* Tags = one swipeable row */

    .episode-tags p:last-child{
        gap:4px;

        padding:3px 0 4px !important;

        overflow-x:auto !important;

        white-space:nowrap !important;
    }


    .episode-tags p:last-child a{
        margin:0 !important;
    }

}



/* =========================================================
   EXTRA SMALL MOBILE
========================================================= */

@media(max-width:480px){

    .episode-tags{
        padding:7px 8px !important;
    }

    .episode-tags p{
        padding:2px 0 !important;
    }

    .episode-tags strong{
        font-size:11px !important;
    }

    .episode-tags a{
        padding:4px 7px !important;

        font-size:10.5px !important;
    }

}

<script>
(function(){

    let searchTimer = null;
    let controller  = null;


    /* =========================================
       CLICK HANDLING
    ========================================= */

    document.addEventListener('click', function(event){

        const openButton =
            event.target.closest('.hs-search-open-btn');

        const closeButton =
            event.target.closest('.hs-search-close');

        const overlay =
            document.getElementById('hs-search-overlay');

        const input =
            document.getElementById('hs-search-input');


        /* -------------------------
           OPEN SEARCH
        ------------------------- */

        if(openButton){

            /*
             * Stop this specific search-button click
             * from bubbling into other click listeners.
             *
             * We intentionally DO NOT use preventDefault().
             */

            event.stopPropagation();

            if(!overlay){
                return;
            }

            overlay.classList.add('active');

            document.body.classList.add(
                'hs-search-active'
            );

            setTimeout(function(){

                if(input){
                    input.focus();
                }

            },100);

            return;
        }


        /* -------------------------
           CLOSE SEARCH
        ------------------------- */

        if(closeButton){

            event.stopPropagation();

            if(overlay){
                overlay.classList.remove('active');
            }

            document.body.classList.remove(
                'hs-search-active'
            );

            return;
        }


        /* -------------------------
           CLICK OUTSIDE MODAL
        ------------------------- */

        if(
            overlay &&
            event.target === overlay
        ){

            overlay.classList.remove('active');

            document.body.classList.remove(
                'hs-search-active'
            );

        }

    });


    /* =========================================
       ESC KEY CLOSE
    ========================================= */

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(event){

        if(event.key !== 'Escape'){
            return;
        }

        const overlay =
            document.getElementById('hs-search-overlay');

        if(overlay){

            overlay.classList.remove('active');

        }

        document.body.classList.remove(
            'hs-search-active'
        );

    });


    /* =========================================
       LIVE AJAX SEARCH
    ========================================= */

    document.addEventListener('input', function(event){

        if(event.target.id !== 'hs-search-input'){
            return;
        }

        const input = event.target;

        const results =
            document.getElementById('hs-live-results');

        if(!results){
            return;
        }


        clearTimeout(searchTimer);


        const keyword =
            input.value.trim();


        /* Minimum 2 characters */

        if(keyword.length < 2){

            results.innerHTML = '';

            return;
        }


        /* Loading */

        results.innerHTML =
            '<div class="hs-live-loading">' +
                '<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> ' +
                'Searching...' +
            '</div>';


        searchTimer = setTimeout(function(){


            /* Check AJAX config */

            if(
                typeof window.hsLiveSearch === 'undefined'
            ){

                results.innerHTML =
                    '<div class="hs-live-empty">' +
                    'Search configuration missing.' +
                    '</div>';

                console.log(
                    'hsLiveSearch configuration missing'
                );

                return;
            }


            /* Cancel previous request */

            if(controller){

                controller.abort();

            }


            controller =
                new AbortController();


            const formData =
                new FormData();


            formData.append(
                'action',
                'hs_live_search'
            );


            formData.append(
                'keyword',
                keyword
            );


            formData.append(
                'nonce',
                window.hsLiveSearch.nonce
            );


            /* AJAX */

            fetch(
                window.hsLiveSearch.ajaxUrl,
                {

                    method:'POST',

                    body:formData,

                    signal:controller.signal

                }
            )

            .then(function(response){

                return response.json();

            })

            .then(function(response){

                if(response.success){

                    results.innerHTML =
                        response.data;

                }else{

                    results.innerHTML =
                        '<div class="hs-live-empty">' +
                        'No results found' +
                        '</div>';

                }

            })

            .catch(function(error){

                if(
                    error.name === 'AbortError'
                ){
                    return;
                }


                console.log(
                    'Search error:',
                    error
                );


                results.innerHTML =
                    '<div class="hs-live-empty">' +
                    'Search unavailable' +
                    '</div>';

            });


        },300);

    });

})();

            <div class="srp_playlist_title" @click="closeExtendedPlayer">{{ list.tracks[currentTrack].album_title }}</div>
            <i class="sricon-3-dots-v srp_ellipsis_btn" @click="openExtendedPlayerOverlay" v-if="list.tracks[currentTrack].song_store_list.length || IRON.sonaar.player.albumStoreList.length"></i>
            <div v-if="!list.tracks[currentTrack].song_store_list.length && !IRON.sonaar.player.albumStoreList.length"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="srp_ext_artwork" v-if="list.tracks.length >= 1 && hasArtwork">
            <img alt="Player Audio Artwork" :src="list.tracks[currentTrack].poster" />
          </div>  
          <div class="srp_ext_content">
            <div class="srp_ext_track" v-if="list.tracks.length >= 1">
              <div class="srp_ext_track_info">
                <div class="srp_track_title">{{list.tracks[currentTrack].track_title}}</div>
                <div class="srp_artist">{{list.tracks[currentTrack].track_artist }}</div>
              </div>
              <cta :player="this" :storeid="'srp-fav-bt'" :label=false></cta>
            </div>
            <waveform :player="this"></waveform>
            <div class="srp_ext_control" v-if="list.tracks.length >= 1">
              <div class="srp_control_left">
                <div role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Shuffle Track" :title="sonaar_music.option.tooltip_shuffle_btn" class="shuffle control--item sricon-shuffle" :class="shuffle ? 'active' : '' " @click="sr_shuffleToggle" v-if="list.tracks.length > 1 && classes.show_shuffle_bt"></div>

              <div class="control" :class="[{srp_ctrl_advanced: classes.show_skip_bt}]">
                <div role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Rewind 15 seconds" :title="sonaar_music.option.tooltip_rwd_btn" class="sr_skipBackward sricon-15s" @click="sr_audioSkipTo(-1 * classes.skipBackward)" v-if="classes.show_skip_bt"></div>
                <div role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Previous Track" :title="sonaar_music.option.tooltip_prev_btn" class="previous control--item sricon-back" @click="previous" v-if="list.tracks.length > 1 && classes.show_nextprevious_bt"></div>
                <div role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Play / Pause" :title="sonaar_music.option.tooltip_play_btn" class="play control--item sricon-play" @click="play"></div>
                <div role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Next Track" :title="sonaar_music.option.tooltip_next_btn" class="next control--item sricon-forward" @click="next" v-if="list.tracks.length > 1 && classes.show_nextprevious_bt"></div>
                <div role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Forward 30 seconds" :title="sonaar_music.option.tooltip_fwrd_btn" class="sr_skipForward sricon-30s" @click="sr_audioSkipTo(classes.skipForward)" v-if="classes.show_skip_bt"></div>
              </div>
              <div class="srp_control_right">
                <div role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Speed Rates" :title="sonaar_music.option.tooltip_speed_btn" class="sr_speedRate" :class="classes.speedRate != 1 ? 'active' : '' " @click="sr_setSpeedRate" v-if="classes.show_speed_bt"><div>{{classes.speedRate}}X</div></div>
                <div role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Repeat" :title="sonaar_music.option.tooltip_repeat_btn" class="srp_repeat sricon-repeat control--item" @click="IRON.repeatButtonToggle" :data-repeat-status="repeatStatus" v-if="repeatButton && !classes.notrackskip"></div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="srp_ext_featured_cta" v-if="list.tracks.length >= 1">
              <div class="srp_ext_featured_cta_left">
                <div role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="View Tracklist" :title="sonaar_music.option.tooltip_tracklist_btn" class="list control--item sricon-list" @click="setshowList" v-if="list.tracks.length > 1 && classes.show_tracklist_bt"></div>
              </div>
              <div class="srp_ext_featured_cta_center" @click="closeExtendedPlayer"></div>
              <div class="srp_ext_featured_cta_right">
                  <cta class="srp_ext_cta_share" :player="this" :storeid="'sr_store_force_share_bt'" :label=false></cta>
                  <cta class="srp_ext_cta_addtocart" :player="this" :storeid="'fas fa-cart-plus'" :label=true></cta>
                  <cta class="srp_ext_cta_buynow" :player="this" :storeid="'fas fa-shopping-cart'" :label=true></cta>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="srp_ext_secondary" v-if="list.tracks.length >= 1 && outputTrackDescription" @click="extendedScrolldown">
          <div v-html="outputTrackDescription" class="srp_ext_section"></div>
        </div>
        
      </div>
    </div>

            </div>
          </div>
         
          <cta :player="this" :storeid="'fas fa-cart-plus'" :label=true></cta>
          <cta :player="this" :storeid="'fas fa-shopping-cart'" :label=true></cta>
          <cta :player="this" :storeid="'sr_store_force_dl_bt'" :label=true></cta>
          <cta :player="this" :storeid="'sr_store_force_share_bt'" :label=true></cta>
          <cta :player="this" :storeid="'srp-fav-bt'" :label=true></cta>
          <cta :player="this" :storeid="'sr_store_force_pl_bt'" :label=true></cta>

            <a :href="cta['store-link']" target="_blank" @click="ctaClick(cta, $(event.target))">
              <i :class="cta['store-icon']"></i>
              {{ cta['store-name'] }}
            </a>
          </span>
      </div>
    </div>

    #hs-live-results {

    /* Search submit button */

    .hs-search-submit {
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        margin-right: 6px;
        padding: 12px 17px;
        border: 0;
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: #ffc107;
        color: #111;
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: 700;
        cursor: pointer;
    }

    .hs-search-submit:hover {
        background: #ffda47;

    /* Results page */

    .hsr-page {
        padding-top: 35px;
        padding-bottom: 50px;
    }

    .hsr-heading {

        margin-bottom: 10px;

    .hsr-query {
        color: #aaa;
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

        color: #fff;
    }

    .hsr-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
        gap: 20px;
    }

        padding: 10px;
        border-radius: 12px;
        background: #151515;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hsr-card a {
        color: inherit;
        text-decoration: none;

        width: 100%;

/* ==========================================
   HEADER LIVE SEARCH
========================================== */

.hs-search-icon{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    width:42px;
    height:42px;

    padding:0;
    margin:0 5px;

    border:0 !important;
    outline:0 !important;

    background:transparent !important;
    color:#ffcc00 !important;

    font-size:20px;
    line-height:1;

    cursor:pointer;

    position:relative;
    z-index:10000;
}

.hs-search-icon:hover,
.hs-search-icon:focus{
    color:#fff !important;
    background:transparent !important;
}


/* ==========================================
   SEARCH OVERLAY
========================================== */

.hs-search-overlay{
    position:fixed;
    inset:0;

    width:100%;
    height:100%;

    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
    align-items:flex-start;

    padding:80px 20px 30px;

    background:rgba(0,0,0,.88);

    z-index:9999999;

    opacity:0;
    visibility:hidden;
    pointer-events:none;

    transition:
        opacity .25s ease,
        visibility .25s ease;
}

.hs-search-overlay.active{
    opacity:1;
    visibility:visible;
    pointer-events:auto;
}

body.hs-search-active{
    overflow:hidden;
}


/* ==========================================
   MODAL
========================================== */

.hs-search-modal{
    position:relative;

    width:100%;
    max-width:720px;

    padding:25px;

    background:#111;

    border-radius:14px;

    box-shadow:0 15px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.65);
}


/* ==========================================
   TITLE
========================================== */

.hs-search-heading{
    margin:0 50px 18px 0;

    color:#fff;

    font-size:24px;
    font-weight:600;
}


/* ==========================================
   CLOSE BUTTON
========================================== */

.hs-search-close{
    position:absolute;

    top:14px;
    right:14px;

    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    width:38px;
    height:38px;

    padding:0;

    border:0 !important;
    border-radius:50%;

    background:#222 !important;
    color:#fff !important;

    font-size:18px;

    cursor:pointer;
}

.hs-search-close:hover{
    background:#ffc107 !important;
    color:#000 !important;

/* =========================================================
   TAGS ROW

   Keep everything on ONE horizontal line.
========================================================= */

.episode-tags p:last-child{
    display:flex !important;

<script>
(function(){

    let searchTimer = null;
    let controller  = null;


    /* =========================================
       CLICK HANDLING
    ========================================= */

    document.addEventListener('click', function(event){

        const openButton =
            event.target.closest('.hs-search-open-btn');

        const closeButton =
            event.target.closest('.hs-search-close');

        const overlay =
            document.getElementById('hs-search-overlay');

        const input =
            document.getElementById('hs-search-input');


        /* -------------------------
           OPEN SEARCH
        ------------------------- */

        if(openButton){

            /*
             * Stop this specific search-button click
             * from bubbling into other click listeners.
             *
             * We intentionally DO NOT use preventDefault().
             */

            event.stopPropagation();

            if(!overlay){
                return;
            }

            overlay.classList.add('active');

            document.body.classList.add(
                'hs-search-active'
            );

            setTimeout(function(){

                if(input){
                    input.focus();
                }

            },100);

            return;
        }


        /* -------------------------
           CLOSE SEARCH
        ------------------------- */

        if(closeButton){

            event.stopPropagation();

            if(overlay){
                overlay.classList.remove('active');
            }

            document.body.classList.remove(
                'hs-search-active'
            );

            return;
        }


        /* -------------------------
           CLICK OUTSIDE MODAL
        ------------------------- */

        if(
            overlay &&
            event.target === overlay
        ){

            overlay.classList.remove('active');

            document.body.classList.remove(
                'hs-search-active'
            );

        }

    });


    /* =========================================
       ESC KEY CLOSE
    ========================================= */

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(event){

        if(event.key !== 'Escape'){
            return;
        }

        const overlay =
            document.getElementById('hs-search-overlay');

        if(overlay){

            overlay.classList.remove('active');

        }

        document.body.classList.remove(
            'hs-search-active'
        );

    });


    /* =========================================
       LIVE AJAX SEARCH
    ========================================= */

    document.addEventListener('input', function(event){

        if(event.target.id !== 'hs-search-input'){
            return;
        }

        const input = event.target;

        const results =
            document.getElementById('hs-live-results');

        if(!results){
            return;
        }


        clearTimeout(searchTimer);


        const keyword =
            input.value.trim();


        /* Minimum 2 characters */

        if(keyword.length < 2){

            results.innerHTML = '';

            return;
        }


        /* Loading */

        results.innerHTML =
            '<div class="hs-live-loading">' +
                '<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> ' +
                'Searching...' +
            '</div>';


        searchTimer = setTimeout(function(){


            /* Check AJAX config */

            if(
                typeof window.hsLiveSearch === 'undefined'
            ){

                results.innerHTML =
                    '<div class="hs-live-empty">' +
                    'Search configuration missing.' +
                    '</div>';

                console.log(
                    'hsLiveSearch configuration missing'
                );

                return;
            }


            /* Cancel previous request */

            if(controller){

                controller.abort();

            }


            controller =
                new AbortController();


            const formData =
                new FormData();


            formData.append(
                'action',
                'hs_live_search'
            );


            formData.append(
                'keyword',
                keyword
            );


            formData.append(
                'nonce',
                window.hsLiveSearch.nonce
            );


            /* AJAX */

            fetch(
                window.hsLiveSearch.ajaxUrl,
                {

                    method:'POST',

                    body:formData,

                    signal:controller.signal

                }
            )

            .then(function(response){

                return response.json();

            })

            .then(function(response){

                if(response.success){

                    results.innerHTML =
                        response.data;

                }else{

                    results.innerHTML =
                        '<div class="hs-live-empty">' +
                        'No results found' +
                        '</div>';

                }

            })

            .catch(function(error){

                if(
                    error.name === 'AbortError'
                ){
                    return;
                }


                console.log(
                    'Search error:',
                    error
                );


                results.innerHTML =
                    '<div class="hs-live-empty">' +
                    'Search unavailable' +
                    '</div>';

            });


        },300);

    });

})();

    (function () {
        'use strict';

        /*
         * Stop the previous live-search
         * input handler from receiving events.
         */
        document.addEventListener('input', function (event) {

            if (
                !event.target ||
                event.target.id !== 'hs-search-input'
            ) {
                return;
            }

            event.stopImmediatePropagation();

            var results = document.getElementById(
                'hs-live-results'
            );

            if (results) {
                results.innerHTML = '';
            }

        }, true);


        function submitHotSeriesSearch(input) {

            var keyword = input.value.trim();

            if (keyword.length < 2) {
                input.focus();
                return;
            }

            var url = new URL('/', window.location.origin);

            url.searchParams.set('s', keyword);

            window.location.assign(url.toString());
        }


        // Press Enter to search.
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {

            if (
                !event.target ||
                event.target.id !== 'hs-search-input'
            ) {
                return;
            }

            if (
                event.key !== 'Enter' ||
                event.isComposing
            ) {
                return;
            }

            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopImmediatePropagation();

            submitHotSeriesSearch(event.target);

        }, true);


        /*
         * Add a Search button inside the
         * existing search field.
         */
        function initializeSearchButton() {

            var input = document.getElementById(
                'hs-search-input'
            );

            if (!input) {
                return;
            }

            var field = input.closest('.hs-search-field');

            if (!field) {
                return;
            }

            // Prevent duplicate buttons.
            if (field.querySelector('.hs-search-submit')) {
                return;
            }

            var button = document.createElement('button');

            button.type = 'button';
            button.className = 'hs-search-submit';
            button.textContent = 'Search';

            button.addEventListener('click', function () {
                submitHotSeriesSearch(input);
            });

            field.appendChild(button);
        }

        if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
            document.addEventListener(
                'DOMContentLoaded',
                initializeSearchButton
            );
        } else {
            initializeSearchButton();
        }

    })();
    </script>

padding:12px 30px;

background:#229ED9;

color:#fff;

border-radius:40px;

text-decoration:none;

font-weight:700;

}

.telegram-btn:hover{

background:#0088cc;

}

#telegram-close{

position:absolute;

right:15px;

top:10px;

border:none;

background:none;

font-size:30px;

color:#fff;

cursor:pointer;

}

@media(max-width:768px){

.telegram-box{

padding:25px;

}

.telegram-box h2{

font-size:24px;

}

}

.telegram-box h2 i{
    color:#229ED9;
    margin-right:10px;
    font-size:32px;
    vertical-align:middle;
}





/* ==========================================
   HEADER LIVE SEARCH
========================================== */

.hs-search-icon{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    width:42px;
    height:42px;

    padding:0;
    margin:0 5px;

    border:0 !important;
    outline:0 !important;

    background:transparent !important;
    color:#ffcc00 !important;

    font-size:20px;
    line-height:1;

    cursor:pointer;

    position:relative;
    z-index:10000;
}

.hs-search-icon:hover,
.hs-search-icon:focus{
    color:#fff !important;
    background:transparent !important;
}


/* ==========================================
   SEARCH OVERLAY
========================================== */

.hs-search-overlay{
    position:fixed;
    inset:0;

    width:100%;
    height:100%;

    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
    align-items:flex-start;

    padding:80px 20px 30px;

    background:rgba(0,0,0,.88);

    z-index:9999999;

    opacity:0;
    visibility:hidden;
    pointer-events:none;

    transition:
        opacity .25s ease,
        visibility .25s ease;
}

.hs-search-overlay.active{
    opacity:1;
    visibility:visible;
    pointer-events:auto;
}

body.hs-search-active{
    overflow:hidden;
}


/* ==========================================
   MODAL
========================================== */

.hs-search-modal{
    position:relative;

    width:100%;
    max-width:720px;

    padding:25px;

    background:#111;

    border-radius:14px;

    box-shadow:0 15px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.65);
}


/* ==========================================
   TITLE
========================================== */

.hs-search-heading{
    margin:0 50px 18px 0;

    color:#fff;

    font-size:24px;
    font-weight:600;
}


/* ==========================================
   CLOSE BUTTON
========================================== */

.hs-search-close{
    position:absolute;

    top:14px;
    right:14px;

    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    width:38px;
    height:38px;

    padding:0;

    border:0 !important;
    border-radius:50%;

    background:#222 !important;
    color:#fff !important;

    font-size:18px;

    cursor:pointer;
}

.hs-search-close:hover{
    background:#ffc107 !important;
    color:#000 !important;
}


/* ==========================================
   SEARCH FIELD
========================================== */

.hs-search-field{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;

    width:100%;

    padding-left:16px;

    background:#222;

    border-radius:10px;
}

.hs-search-field > i{
    flex:0 0 auto;

    color:#ffc107;

    font-size:18px;
}

#hs-search-input{
    width:100%;

    padding:15px;

    border:0 !important;
    outline:0 !important;

    background:transparent !important;

    color:#fff;

    font-size:18px;

    box-shadow:none !important;
}

#hs-search-input:focus{
    border:0 !important;
    outline:0 !important;
    box-shadow:none !important;
}

#hs-search-input::placeholder{
    color:#999;
}


/* ==========================================
   RESULTS
========================================== */

.hs-live-results{
    width:100%;

    max-height:520px;

    margin-top:15px;

    overflow-y:auto;
}

.hs-live-result{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;

    gap:15px;

    padding:10px;
    margin-bottom:8px;

    background:#1b1b1b;

    border-radius:9px;

    text-decoration:none !important;

    transition:.2s;
}

.hs-live-result:hover{
    background:#292929;
}


/* ==========================================
   RESULT THUMBNAIL
========================================== */

.hs-live-thumb{
    width:115px;
    flex:0 0 115px;
}

.hs-live-thumb img{
    display:block;

    width:100%;
    height:65px;

    object-fit:cover;

    border-radius:7px;
}

.hs-live-no-image{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    width:100%;
    height:65px;

    background:#292929;

    border-radius:7px;

    color:#777;
}


/* ==========================================
   RESULT INFORMATION
========================================== */

.hs-live-info{
    flex:1;
    min-width:0;
}

.hs-live-title{
    color:#fff;

    font-size:15px;
    line-height:1.5;
    font-weight:500;
}


/* Models / Series / OTT / Tags */

.hs-live-meta{
    margin-top:6px;

    color:#999;

    font-size:12px;
    line-height:1.5;
}

.hs-live-meta i{
    color:#ffc107;
    margin-right:3px;
}

.hs-meta-dot{
    display:inline-block;

    margin:0 7px;

    color:#555;
}


/* ==========================================
   LOADING / EMPTY
========================================== */

.hs-live-loading,
.hs-live-empty{
    padding:30px 15px;

    color:#aaa;

    text-align:center;
}


/* ==========================================
   MOBILE
========================================== */

@media(max-width:768px){

    .hs-search-icon{
        width:38px;
        height:38px;

        margin:0 3px;

        font-size:18px;
    }

    .hs-search-overlay{
        padding:65px 10px 85px;
    }

    .hs-search-modal{
        padding:18px;
    }

    .hs-search-heading{
        font-size:20px;
    }

    #hs-search-input{
        padding:13px;

        font-size:16px;
    }

    .hs-live-thumb{
        width:90px;
        flex-basis:90px;
    }

    .hs-live-thumb img,
    .hs-live-no-image{
        height:55px;
    }

    .hs-live-title{
        font-size:14px;
    }

    .hs-live-meta{
        font-size:11px;
        margin-top:4px;
    }

}




/* =========================================================
   COMPACT SINGLE POST TAXONOMY BOX
   Series / Models / Category / Tags
   PASTE THIS AT VERY BOTTOM OF ADDITIONAL CSS
========================================================= */


/* Main taxonomy box */

.episode-tags{
    width:100%;
    box-sizing:border-box;

    background:#111;

    padding:10px 14px !important;
    margin-top:12px !important;

    border-radius:12px;

    overflow:hidden;
}


/* ==========================================
   SERIES / MODELS / CATEGORY / TAG ROWS
========================================== */

.episode-tags p{
    margin:0 !important;
    padding:4px 0 !important;

    line-height:1.35 !important;
}


/* Yellow labels */

.episode-tags strong{
    display:inline-block;

    color:#ffc107 !important;

    margin-right:6px !important;

    white-space:nowrap;
}


/* Taxonomy buttons */

.episode-tags a{
    display:inline-block !important;

    background:#222 !important;
    color:#fff !important;

    padding:5px 10px !important;

    margin:1px 3px 1px 0 !important;

    border-radius:20px !important;

    font-size:12px !important;

    line-height:1.4 !important;

    white-space:nowrap;

    text-decoration:none !important;

    transition:.2s;
}


/* Hover */

.episode-tags a:hover{
    background:#ffc107 !important;
    color:#000 !important;
}



/* =========================================================
   TAGS ROW
   Your Tags row is the LAST <p> in this box.
   Keep everything on ONE horizontal line.
========================================================= */

.episode-tags p:last-child{
    display:flex !important;

    align-items:center;

    width:100%;

    gap:5px;

    margin:0 !important;

    padding:4px 0 5px !important;

    overflow-x:auto !important;
    overflow-y:hidden !important;

    white-space:nowrap !important;

    -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;

    scrollbar-width:none;
}


/* Hide scrollbar - Chrome/Safari */

.episode-tags p:last-child::-webkit-scrollbar{
    display:none;
}


/* Keep "Tags :" at beginning */

.episode-tags p:last-child strong{
    flex:0 0 auto;
}


/* Each tag stays separate and does not wrap */

.episode-tags p:last-child a{
    flex:0 0 auto;

    margin:0 !important;
}



/* =========================================================
   MOBILE
========================================================= */

@media(max-width:768px){

    .episode-tags{
        padding:8px 9px !important;
        margin-top:8px !important;

        border-radius:10px;
    }


    /* Reduce spacing between
       Series / Models / Category / Tags */

    .episode-tags p{
        margin:0 !important;
        padding:3px 0 !important;

        line-height:1.25 !important;
    }


    .episode-tags strong{
        margin-right:4px !important;

        font-size:12px !important;
    }


    .episode-tags a{
        padding:4px 8px !important;

        margin:1px 2px 1px 0 !important;

        font-size:11px !important;

        line-height:1.3 !important;
    }


    /* Tags = one swipeable row */

    .episode-tags p:last-child{
        gap:4px;

        padding:3px 0 4px !important;

        overflow-x:auto !important;

        white-space:nowrap !important;
    }


    .episode-tags p:last-child a{
        margin:0 !important;
    }

}



/* =========================================================
   EXTRA SMALL MOBILE
========================================================= */

@media(max-width:480px){

    .episode-tags{
        padding:7px 8px !important;
    }

    .episode-tags p{
        padding:2px 0 !important;
    }

    .episode-tags strong{
        font-size:11px !important;
    }

    .episode-tags a{
        padding:4px 7px !important;

        font-size:10.5px !important;
    }

}

<script>
(function(){

    let searchTimer = null;
    let controller  = null;


    /* =========================================
       CLICK HANDLING
    ========================================= */

    document.addEventListener('click', function(event){

        const openButton =
            event.target.closest('.hs-search-open-btn');

        const closeButton =
            event.target.closest('.hs-search-close');

        const overlay =
            document.getElementById('hs-search-overlay');

        const input =
            document.getElementById('hs-search-input');


        /* -------------------------
           OPEN SEARCH
        ------------------------- */

        if(openButton){

            /*
             * Stop this specific search-button click
             * from bubbling into other click listeners.
             *
             * We intentionally DO NOT use preventDefault().
             */

            event.stopPropagation();

            if(!overlay){
                return;
            }

            overlay.classList.add('active');

            document.body.classList.add(
                'hs-search-active'
            );

            setTimeout(function(){

                if(input){
                    input.focus();
                }

            },100);

            return;
        }


        /* -------------------------
           CLOSE SEARCH
        ------------------------- */

        if(closeButton){

            event.stopPropagation();

            if(overlay){
                overlay.classList.remove('active');
            }

            document.body.classList.remove(
                'hs-search-active'
            );

            return;
        }


        /* -------------------------
           CLICK OUTSIDE MODAL
        ------------------------- */

        if(
            overlay &&
            event.target === overlay
        ){

            overlay.classList.remove('active');

            document.body.classList.remove(
                'hs-search-active'
            );

        }

    });


    /* =========================================
       ESC KEY CLOSE
    ========================================= */

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(event){

        if(event.key !== 'Escape'){
            return;
        }

        const overlay =
            document.getElementById('hs-search-overlay');

        if(overlay){

            overlay.classList.remove('active');

        }

        document.body.classList.remove(
            'hs-search-active'
        );

    });


    /* =========================================
       LIVE AJAX SEARCH
    ========================================= */

    document.addEventListener('input', function(event){

        if(event.target.id !== 'hs-search-input'){
            return;
        }

        const input = event.target;

        const results =
            document.getElementById('hs-live-results');

        if(!results){
            return;
        }


        clearTimeout(searchTimer);


        const keyword =
            input.value.trim();


        /* Minimum 2 characters */

        if(keyword.length < 2){

            results.innerHTML = '';

            return;
        }


        /* Loading */

        results.innerHTML =
            '<div class="hs-live-loading">' +
                '<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> ' +
                'Searching...' +
            '</div>';


        searchTimer = setTimeout(function(){


            /* Check AJAX config */

            if(
                typeof window.hsLiveSearch === 'undefined'
            ){

                results.innerHTML =
                    '<div class="hs-live-empty">' +
                    'Search configuration missing.' +
                    '</div>';

                console.log(
                    'hsLiveSearch configuration missing'
                );

                return;
            }


            /* Cancel previous request */

            if(controller){

                controller.abort();

            }


            controller =
                new AbortController();


            const formData =
                new FormData();


            formData.append(
                'action',
                'hs_live_search'
            );


            formData.append(
                'keyword',
                keyword
            );


            formData.append(
                'nonce',
                window.hsLiveSearch.nonce
            );


            /* AJAX */

            fetch(
                window.hsLiveSearch.ajaxUrl,
                {

                    method:'POST',

                    body:formData,

                    signal:controller.signal

                }
            )

            .then(function(response){

                return response.json();

            })

            .then(function(response){

                if(response.success){

                    results.innerHTML =
                        response.data;

                }else{

                    results.innerHTML =
                        '<div class="hs-live-empty">' +
                        'No results found' +
                        '</div>';

                }

            })

            .catch(function(error){

                if(
                    error.name === 'AbortError'
                ){
                    return;
                }


                console.log(
                    'Search error:',
                    error
                );


                results.innerHTML =
                    '<div class="hs-live-empty">' +
                    'Search unavailable' +
                    '</div>';

            });


        },300);

    });

})();

    (function () {
        'use strict';

        /*
         * Stop the previous live-search
         * input handler from receiving events.
         */
        document.addEventListener('input', function (event) {

            if (
                !event.target ||
                event.target.id !== 'hs-search-input'
            ) {
                return;
            }

            event.stopImmediatePropagation();

            var results = document.getElementById(
                'hs-live-results'
            );

            if (results) {
                results.innerHTML = '';
            }

        }, true);


        function submitHotSeriesSearch(input) {

            var keyword = input.value.trim();

            if (keyword.length < 2) {
                input.focus();
                return;
            }

            var url = new URL('/', window.location.origin);

            url.searchParams.set('s', keyword);

            window.location.assign(url.toString());
        }


        // Press Enter to search.
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {

            if (
                !event.target ||
                event.target.id !== 'hs-search-input'
            ) {
                return;
            }

            if (
                event.key !== 'Enter' ||
                event.isComposing
            ) {
                return;
            }

            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopImmediatePropagation();

            submitHotSeriesSearch(event.target);

        }, true);


        /*
         * Add a Search button inside the
         * existing search field.
         */
        function initializeSearchButton() {

            var input = document.getElementById(
                'hs-search-input'
            );

            if (!input) {
                return;
            }

            var field = input.closest('.hs-search-field');

            if (!field) {
                return;
            }

            // Prevent duplicate buttons.
            if (field.querySelector('.hs-search-submit')) {
                return;
            }

            var button = document.createElement('button');

            button.type = 'button';
            button.className = 'hs-search-submit';
            button.textContent = 'Search';

            button.addEventListener('click', function () {
                submitHotSeriesSearch(input);
            });

            field.appendChild(button);
        }

        if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
            document.addEventListener(
                'DOMContentLoaded',
                initializeSearchButton
            );
        } else {
            initializeSearchButton();
        }

    })();
    </script>
